Package hadur2.core.role

Class SentryFence

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.role.SentryFence
public final class SentryFence extends Object
Treats the sentries' border as a wall for the duel's movement (GATE-3). The duel's movement knows only the real walls, so its orders are checked instead: the robot is simulated HORIZON ticks ahead under them, and if it would come within MARGIN px of the border zone (or is already there), the orders are replaced by a drive toward the field's centre. Gun, radar and fire orders pass through untouched.
